title: A real backed-enum value guard narrows a string to value-of

ground_truth.statement: The guard rejects every string except the two backing values. Thus the subsequent fromValue call satisfies value-of<Color>, and runtime checks both enum cases and a rejected string.

provenance.note: The full source has empty asserting functions and null values disguised by @var annotations. Replaced those assumptions with a runtime-enforced guard and a real backed enum; retained the value-of consumer.

notes: Portable semantic reduction measures backing-value narrowing, not Psalm-specific assertion-tag recognition. No empty assertion is trusted as proof. PHPStan and Psalm are clean. Mago reports possibly-invalid-argument at line 8 despite the guard proving that the input is one of the two backing values. That FP is retained.
